messages.author: 486a8894d0e8cc54
messages.subject: rbase and filter handling
parts:
I passed in some filter commands e.g. { LIMIT=>2 },  to hb.scan and there was no effect.

So I used tcpdump to dump the packet payloads going to the hbase/thrift server. I could see that the filter command was not getting included in the payload to the thrift server. So it looks like this is there as a future hook, or maybe I used it incorrectly. It could be that the supporting API call, hbScannerOpenFilter, could does not process the argument yet.

I also started to look into filter support through the openScanner Hbase/Thrift API. It looks like it is not there yet. 

http://wiki.apache.org/hadoop/Hbase/ThriftApi

But, I did start to track new development in customer filters via the Thrift Interface. 

https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/HBASE-5428, schedule for Hbase release 0.94.0. I currently working with hbase version 0.90.4 on my Mac OS X development box. 

--

Owen

messages.author: 1eafd5d24fb29c12
messages.subject: Re: rbase and filter handling
parts:
It's been on my list to update the Thrift generated client C++ code.  If the TScan parameter is generated correctly we should be able to support string filters.  I'll give a whirl early next week.

On Thursday, July 12, 2012 7:00:41 AM UTC-7, Jeffrey Breen wrote:
Hi David:

Just a quick follow-up on this. It sure would be great to be able to filter, but I don't think scannerOpenWithFilterString() is ever coming to the Thrift API based on this comment I found to HBASE-4176 (Exposing HBase Filters to the Thrift API) <http://mail-archives.apache.org/mod_mbox/hbase-issues/201108.mbox/%3C1613556143.40318.1313461948818.JavaMail.tom...@hel.zones.apache.org%3E>:

Removed the powerset of scannerOpenWithFilterString* methods from the Thrift file and introduced
another optional argument in the TScan struct that takes a filterString

Sure enough, I see the filterString in TScan, but haven't looked around or learned enough about Thrift of rhbase's C/C++ code to help further, yet <http://svn.apache.org/viewvc/hbase/trunk/hbase-server/src/main/resources/org/apache/hadoop/hbase/thrift/Hbase.thrift?view=markup>:

struct TScan {

1:optional Text startRow,

2:optional Text stopRow,

3:optional i64 timestamp,

4:optional list<Text> columns,

5:optional i32 caching,

6:optional Text filterString

}

Thanks,
Jeffrey
